snippet.title: Tide of Lone Stars - Game Teaser Trailer | Paths Are Forking
snippet.description:
—Every choice comes with a price that must be paid.

Tide of Lone Stars is an ADV / AVG with conventional gameplay and unconventional apocalyptic sci-fi narrative. As a disabled girl living outside the walls, Blanka, you will meet a strange man, Adrian. An amazing adventure of "Love, Rebirth and Death" is ready to begin.
Add "Tide of Lone Stars" to your wishlist!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3442960/Tide_of_Lone_Stars/
